function.name: execute-command
function.description: Execute a Minecraft command. Use this to perform in-game actions. Requires: command (string)

function.name: list-tools
function.description: List all available tools with their names and descriptions. Use this to see what tools are available in the system.

function.name: tool-info-request
function.description: Request detailed information about a specific tool. Use this when you need to understand how to use a tool properly. (Detailed guide available via tool-info-request)

tool_name.description: The name of the tool to get information about

layer.description: The level of detail needed: LAYER_1 (basic), LAYER_2 (detailed), LAYER_3 (full guide)
